scope.method: Dependency-focused review of current unchecked sections; not an item-by-item audit of all 92 tasks

generalConceptIdentity.meaning: broader concept registry; not a classifier label table

topology.meaning: traversal/topology read model; not identity authority

criticalPath.action: Retain the frozen split of classifier labels, domain identity, general concepts, topology, version/alias bridge, and legacy packet observations.
criticalPath.exitCondition: All future tasks refer to the correct owner; no table is silently promoted to universal registry.

criticalPath.action: Build a pure read-side normalizer over the frozen vocabulary census. Preserve raw label/evidence; classify exact, alias, subtype, non-domain, ambiguous, or quarantined; unresolved stays unmapped.
prohibited: infer ui→frontend or ml→machine-learning without explicit mapping evidence
criticalPath.exitCondition: Deterministic report checksum plus fail-closed fixture for unresolved and mixed legacy values.

criticalPath.action: Fixture/disposable proof of explicit mappings and rejection cases; keep production adapter unpopulated.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Same input yields same mapping checksum; unknown, ambiguous, revisionless, and wrong-owner values reject without writes.

criticalPath.action: Reconcile the selected terminal workspace snapshot, source namespace, packet/source binding, content hash, and source revision before concept admission.
criticalPath.exitCondition: One current snapshot-bound receipt binds source namespace, sourceRef, source/content revision, and workspace revision; missing namespace or source binding remains a hard reject.

criticalPath.action: Refresh the raw-label inventory across packet labels, trace selections, Valkey indexes, and Neo4j Concept nodes in a single read-only evidence frame; existing packet/trace inventory is only partial for this gate.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Counts, normalized aliases, ambiguous/unmapped values, and evidence-source revisions are reconciled without merging or deleting concepts. This census does not admit concepts.

criticalPath.action: Resolve normalized values only against explicitly declared ontology classes and the correct identity owner; never use a classifier label or topology node as a concept ID.
criticalPath.historicalEvidence: Prior preview recorded 18 explicit mapping matches, 0 ambiguous, 19,427 unmapped; prior task census described atlas_ontology_concepts as empty. The task ledger also records 3,352 classifier rows with only 148 revision-qualified Graphify joins, zero declared source namespaces, and a 52/52 source-revision match cohort with 0/52 current-workspace revision matches. These are historical receipts, not current live counts.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Every admitted mapping identifies source vocabulary, target owner/ID, mapping revision, ontology revision, exact evidence, and source lineage; unresolved stays rejected.

criticalPath.action: Re-run the grounded tuple admission fixture with exact sourceRef/span, source and workspace revisions, mapping/ontology revisions, evidence refs, and tuple checksum.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Deterministic fixture passes twice; no registry, graph, or cache write.

criticalPath.action: Only after the grounded fixture and owner mapping pass, decide whether to authorize the existing canonical concepts/relations migration and a bounded seed; the ledger says the global Drizzle migration baseline is unresolved.
criticalPath.exitCondition: If declined, keep proposals local/unadmitted. If approved later, use existing canonical tables with transactional write plus independent readback; no new taxonomy table.

criticalPath.action: Project only admitted PostgreSQL concepts to Neo4j; then create one revisioned shared graph artifact and derive bounded topology/geometry features as non-canonical projections.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Projection counts/checksums and ordinal map read back against canonical concepts; graph/geometry adds no identity or retrieval vote.

criticalPath.action: Build a source-split revisioned classifier snapshot, establish XGBoost baseline, consider PyTorch only as a challenger, then perform deterministic read-only replay.
criticalPath.exitCondition: Two replays have equal source/mapping/ontology/projection/feature/prediction checksums; no model output changes canonical ontology.

parallelButNotCritical.reason: Requires a real revision-qualified tuple producer/admission authority; the fanout DDL is draft-only and explicitly gated.
Must bind capture identity/content hash/evidence revision; it cannot bypass canonical concept admission.

parallelButNotCritical.gate: OAK construction benchmarks / GEPA / reinforcement learning
parallelButNotCritical.reason: Do not precede ontology ownership, grounded source lineage, and deterministic baseline.

quickImplementationHops.title: Run pure DomainClassNormalizerV1 fixtures and the independent same-frame raw-label inventory
Resolve only explicitly declared owner/mapping identities against the refreshed inventory
Projection/readback, shared graph, then model baseline

limitations: No live database re-query was performed; prior row counts cited in the task ledger are labeled historical.
This report prioritizes the ontology/concept admission critical path and does not classify all 92 unchecked tasks individually.
